payload.name: Jobber
payload.description: 在 Jobber 中从答案到行动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your Jobber business context into ChatGPT. Get answers and take action across your clients, quotes, jobs, invoices, and schedule. payload.name: REMAX D-A-CH
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: REMAX helps users find residential listings from REMAX Austria, Germany, and Switzerland in ChatGPT. Users can search by location, price, property type, rooms, size, amenities, and visual attributes; count matching listings; and retrieve a specific listing by remax.at, remax.de, or remax.ch URL. payload.name: Userback

Userback helps teams turn customer feedback into clear, actionable insights so bugs, usability issues, and feature requests are understood and addressed more efficiently across the business.
payload.longDescription:
收集、理解并处理用户反馈。

将 Userback 数据连接到 ChatGPT，让你无需在工具之间切换，就能更轻松地查看、理解和管理客户反馈。团队可以快速访问反馈条目、查看截图和技术详情、总结报告，并判断下一步需要关注什么。

连接 Userback 后，产品、工程和支持团队可以更快地对新收到的反馈进行分诊，发现客户报告中的模式，并直接在 AI 工作流中创建、更新和评论反馈条目，让工作持续推进。

Userback 帮助团队将客户反馈转化为清晰、可执行的洞察，让业务各部门更高效地理解和处理错误、易用性问题及功能请求。

payload.name: Startup Name Generator

payload.name: Lloyd by The L Suite
payload.description: 获取企业法务同行见解
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Peer legal insights for in-house counsel from The L Suite, the leading in-house counsel community.   Get peer advice, find counsel, issue-spot contracts, benchmarks and more. Members Only.

Lloyd by The L Suite brings peer intelligence from a private community of 2,500+ in-house general counsel and their teams into ChatGPT. Ask what in-house peers have done or said on any legal topic — negotiation approaches, precedent, playbooks, and benchmarks — and get attributed insights with citations and community sources (get_peer_insights), or source the legal tooling, service providers, and outside counsel that peers actually use (find_vendors). Results are scoped to the member's own L Suite peer networks — exactly what they see on-platform. Read-only; no records are created or modified.
payload.longDescription:
The L Suite 是领先的企业内部法律顾问社群，为企业法务提供同行法律见解。获取同行建议、寻找法律顾问、识别合同问题、查看基准数据等。仅限会员。

Lloyd by The L Suite 将由 2,500 多名企业总法律顾问及其团队组成的私人社群中的同行经验带入 ChatGPT。你可以询问企业法务同行在任何法律议题上的做法或观点，例如谈判方式、先例、操作手册和基准数据；获取带有引用和社群来源的归属明确的见解（get_peer_insights），或查找同行实际使用的法律工具、服务提供商和外部法律顾问（find_vendors）。结果仅限于该会员自己的 L Suite 同行网络，也就是其在平台上可见的内容。此功能为只读，不会创建或修改记录。

payload.name: Smartling
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Smartling is a cloud-based translation management platform used by global brands to translate and manage localized content at scale. This MCP server brings Smartling's translation and localization tools directly into your AI assistant.

What you can do:
- Translate text instantly using Smartling's MT API, applying your glossary, style guide, and preferred terminology
- Search, tag, and review strings across your projects
- Create, monitor, and manage translation jobs — add or remove content, authorize work, and review job history
- Raise, track, and resolve string issues and quality questions between reviewers and linguists
- Look up glossaries, style guides, translation memory, and linguistic packages to check terminology and brand voice
- Review vendor and translator assignments, word count reports, and workflow details
- List projects, users, and accounts across your Smartling organization

Who it's for:
Localization managers, project managers, and engineers already working in Smartling who want fast answers or bulk actions without leaving their AI assistant — checking a job's status, triaging quality issues, pulling a report, or getting an instant translation.
payload.longDescription:
Smartling 是云端翻译管理平台，全球品牌使用它大规模翻译和管理本地化内容。此 MCP 服务器将 Smartling 的翻译和本地化工具直接带入你的 AI 助手。

你可以：
- 使用 Smartling 的 MT API 即时翻译文本，并应用术语表、风格指南和首选术语
- 在各项目中搜索、标记和审阅字符串
- 创建、监控和管理翻译任务——添加或移除内容、授权工作并查看任务历史
- 提出、跟踪并解决审校人员与语言专家之间的字符串问题和质量疑问
- 查阅术语表、风格指南、翻译记忆库和语言资源包，以核对术语和品牌语气
- 查看供应商和译员分配、字数报告及工作流详情
- 列出 Smartling 组织中的项目、用户和账户

适用对象：
已在使用 Smartling、希望无需离开 AI 助手即可快速查询或批量操作的本地化经理、项目经理和工程师，例如检查任务状态、分流质量问题、获取报告或即时翻译。

payload.name: adplane
payload.description: 管理 Google Ads 和 Meta Ads
payload.summaryOriginal: Manage Google Ads and Meta Ads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your live account data, on either platform or both at once. Compare campaigns across any date range, find where spend is going, pull search terms, put Google and Meta results side by side, or write raw GAQL when you need something the report builder does not cover. Money is returned in your account currency, already converted, so numbers can be read as-is.

Adplane also builds and changes campaigns. On Google it can create Search campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and responsive search ads, and add negative keywords. On Meta it can create campaigns, ad sets, ads, and creatives built from images and video you provide, with live previews. On both platforms it can update names, budgets, bids, and status on things that already exist.

Everything Adplane creates starts paused. A new campaign cannot serve or spend until you explicitly ask to turn it on, and turning something on is a separate, deliberate step through a single tool per platform. Negative keywords only restrict where ads show and can never spend. Deleting is limited to removing a campaign that has never spent, for cleaning up a draft you abandoned; there is no bulk delete. Every change is read back from the platform after it is applied, so what you see reported is what the platform actually stored.

Connecting takes one click. Sign in with the Google account you already use for Google Ads and every account you have access to is connected at once. Meta ad accounts connect from your accounts page with a Facebook sign-in.

Requires a Google Ads or Meta ad account and an Adplane account at adplane.ai.
payload.longDescription:
Adplane 将你的 Google Ads 和 Meta Ads 账号连接到 ChatGPT，让你在同一段对话中分析表现并进行修改。

用自然语言提问，从任一平台或同时从两个平台的实时账号数据获得答案。比较任意日期范围内的广告系列、了解资金支出去向、提取搜索词、并排查看 Google 和 Meta 的结果，或在报告生成器无法满足需求时编写原始 GAQL。金额已转换为你的账号币种，可直接读取。

Adplane 还可创建和修改广告系列。在 Google 上，它可以创建搜索广告系列、广告组、关键词和自适应搜索广告，并添加否定关键词。在 Meta 上，它可以创建广告系列、广告组、广告，以及使用你提供的图片和视频制作的广告素材，并提供实时预览。在两个平台上，它都可以更新现有项目的名称、预算、出价和状态。

Adplane 创建的所有内容初始均为暂停状态。只有你明确要求启用，新广告系列才能投放或产生支出；启用是单独、主动执行的步骤，每个平台通过一个专门工具完成。否定关键词只会限制广告展示位置，绝不会产生支出。删除仅限于移除从未产生支出的广告系列，以清理放弃的草稿；不提供批量删除。每次修改应用后都会从平台读取核对，因此报告显示的就是平台实际保存的内容。

只需点击一次即可连接。使用你已经用于 Google Ads 的 Google 账号登录，你有权访问的所有账号都会一次连接。Meta 广告账号通过账号页面使用 Facebook 登录连接。

需要 Google Ads 或 Meta 广告账号，以及 adplane.ai 上的 Adplane 账号。

payload.name: Rhythms
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI agents are powerful but context-blind. They don't know your priorities, what's been decided, how teams are organized, or what your company has learned. Rhythms gives ChatGPT a live, two-way connection to your organization's strategic context — goals, decisions, knowledge, teams, and progress. Query what matters. Create goals and documents. Generate business reviews from live data. Everything you contribute makes the context richer for your entire organization.
payload.longDescription:
该插件AI 战略与运营。以下功能和限制适用：

payload.name: Levitate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Levitate app gives you natural language access to your relationship marketing platform. Search and manage contacts, view full profiles, add tags in bulk, and stay on top of action items — all through conversation. You can also track donations and fundraising campaigns, manage sales opportunities across pipeline stages, and review insurance policies.
payload.longDescription: Levitate 应用让你可以用自然语言访问关系营销平台。搜索和管理联系人，查看完整档案，批量添加标签，并跟进待办事项——全部通过对话完成。你还可以追踪捐赠和筹款活动，管理销售管道各阶段的商机，以及查看保险保单。

payload.name: Expertise Live Chatbot
payload.description: 根据网站构建聊天机器人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Expertise AI turns any website into a working AI agent, right inside ChatGPT. Share a URL and it reads the site's key pages, then trains a live agent that answers questions using that site's actual content. The whole thing takes about a minute.

You get a link to a live preview where you can start chatting with the agent right away. No account, no setup, nothing to install.

Things you can do:
• Try it on your own site and see what an AI agent trained on your content would tell your customers.
• Test how an agent handles your docs, pricing, and product questions before putting one on your website.

Ask ChatGPT to "build an AI agent for mycompany.com" and see for yourself.
payload.longDescription:
Expertise AI 可直接在 ChatGPT 中将任何网站变成可运行的 AI 代理。分享网址后，它会读取网站的关键页面，并训练一个基于网站实际内容回答问题的在线代理。整个过程大约需要一分钟。

你会获得在线预览链接，可立即开始与代理聊天。无需账户、无需设置，也无需安装任何内容。

你可以：
• 在自己的网站上试用，看看基于网站内容训练的 AI 代理会如何回答客户问题。
• 在将代理部署到网站之前，测试它如何处理文档、定价和产品问题。

向 ChatGPT 提出“为 mycompany.com 构建一个 AI 代理”，亲自体验。

payload.description: 适用于网站的 AI 聊天机器人

This app allows ChatGPT to search your knowledge base and access analytics reports in real-time. It can even analyze your knowledge, identify content gaps and fill them in automatically.

payload.longDescription:
BubblaV 可通过智能客户对话改造你的网站。BubblaV AI Chatbot 提供即时支持、收集潜在客户信息，并在需要时无缝转接人工客服。

此应用允许 ChatGPT 搜索你的知识库并实时访问分析报告。它还可以分析知识内容、识别内容缺口并自动补充。

知识搜索 API
为你的内部工具创建一个简单的搜索 API。

payload.name: Fintech Explainer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fintech Explainer helps users understand fintech and AI news shaping the financial industry in Europe and the broader fintech ecosystem. The app explains industry developments, market shifts, and emerging technologies in clear language, with context on what they mean for banks, startups, regulators, and financial professionals.

Built on the editorial archive of Fintech.hu, a Hungarian fintech publication, the app interprets and explains articles originally published in Hungarian, turning them into structured, easy-to-understand insights.
payload.longDescription:
Fintech Explainer 用清晰语言解释欧洲金融科技和 AI 新闻、行业变化、市场转向及新技术，说明对银行、初创企业、监管机构和金融从业者的影响；内容来自

Fintech.hu 匈牙利语编辑档案。

payload.name: RAMMP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RAMMP helps founders and marketers find out why their marketing isn't converting. It computes a free 0-100 Brand Trust Score from a business's own Google Analytics figures and revenue goals, pinpoints the weakest stages of the funnel using the ADORE framework, and returns the highest-impact fixes. A full report tool expands this into per-milestone scores with prescriptive guidance, and a set of helper tools give stage-specific advice for strategy, branding, website, commitment, onboarding, and retention. All tools are read-only: they compute and return guidance from the inputs the user provides and never modify the user's data or any external system.
payload.longDescription: RAMMP 帮助创始人和营销人员找出营销未转化的原因。它根据企业自己的 Google Analytics 数据和收入目标，免费计算 0–100 的品牌信任分，使用 ADORE 框架找出漏斗最薄弱阶段，并返回影响最大的修复建议。完整报告工具会扩展为逐里程碑评分和处方式指导，辅助工具则针对策略、品牌、网站、承诺、入职和留存提供阶段建议。所有工具均为只读：只根据用户提供的输入计算并返回指导，绝不会修改用户数据或任何外部系统。

payload.name: Dathent
payload.description: 规划并发布社交媒体帖子
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dathent is an AI content assistant for brands. Set up your brand profile, get a weekly content plan, generate post drafts with captions and visuals, schedule them to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Threads and Telegram, and track how published posts perform — all from chat. Drafts are never auto-published without your confirmation.
payload.longDescription: Dathent 是面向品牌的 AI 内容助手。设置品牌档案、获取每周内容计划、生成包含文案和视觉素材的帖子草稿，并将其排期发布到 Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、LinkedIn、X、Threads 和 Telegram，还可跟踪已发布帖子的表现——全部在聊天中完成。未经你确认，草稿绝不会自动发布。

payload.name: Salesflare

The app can list CRM records, inspect an account feed, create new accounts, contacts, opportunities, and tasks, and update existing CRM records in the user's Salesflare workspace.
payload.longDescription: Salesflare 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中查找和管理 CRM 账户、联系人、商机、销售渠道、标签、任务和用户。此应用可以列出 CRM 记录、查看账户动态、创建账户/联系人/商机/任务，并更新用户 Salesflare 工作区中的现有 CRM 记录。

payload.name: AdPage

payload.longDescription: AdPage 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看营销表现、归因、收入、漏斗、追踪质量、Google Tag Manager 设置，以及已连接广告平台的数据。

payload.name: Feedbk.ai Survey Agent

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create conversational surveys or interviews in seconds directly from your AI assistant. The Feedbk.ai Survey Agent enables you to design and share surveys with built-in AI probing for deeper insights.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 AI 助手，几秒钟内创建对话式问卷或访谈。Feedbk.ai Survey Agent 可帮助你设计并分享问卷，并内置 AI 追问功能，挖掘更深入的见解。

payload.name: Loop AI
payload.description: 餐饮行业 AI 代理

Loop AI connects your delivery, POS, and review data to recover lost revenue, catch operational issues across locations, and turn customer feedback into action — so your data runs the business instead of just reporting on it.
payload.longDescription: 为餐饮和零售品牌带来盈利增长的 AI 代理。Loop AI 将配送、POS 和评价数据连接起来，挽回流失收入，发现各门店的运营问题，并将客户反馈转化为行动——让数据真正运营业务，而不只是生成报告。

payload.name: LetsBot

Send and receive messages, manage contacts and labels, use AI-powered auto-replies, and integrate with Salla & Zid e-commerce platforms. Perfect for businesses using WhatsApp for customer support and sales.
payload.longDescription: LetsBot 让你直接在 ChatGPT 中管理 WhatsApp 商务对话。发送和接收消息、管理联系人和标签、使用 AI 自动回复，并与 Salla 和 Zid 电商平台集成。非常适合使用 WhatsApp 进行客户支持和销售的企业。

payload.name: 100Hires ATS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Recruiters use 100Hires to track jobs, candidates, applications, interviews, and evaluations. This connector lets ChatGPT read your real ATS data and act on it — move candidates between stages, schedule interviews, send templated rejection or outreach messages, log evaluations, and create candidates from resumes. Works with your existing 100Hires account and permissions.
payload.longDescription: 招聘人员使用 100Hires 跟踪职位、候选人、申请、面试和评估。此连接器让 ChatGPT 读取真实的 ATS 数据并对其执行操作——将候选人移至不同阶段、安排面试、发送模板化的拒绝或邀约消息、记录评估，以及根据简历创建候选人。使用现有 100Hires 账户及其权限。

payload.name: Alhena AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get instant answers about how Alhena AI helps ecommerce brands win AI search, convert shoppers, and deflect support tickets, grounded in Alhena's docs, pricing, blog, and case studies. Explore the Shopping Concierge, Support Concierge, AEO, voice, and agent assist, see which helpdesks and storefronts it integrates with (Shopify, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Intercom, and more), and estimate ROI from verified customer results. payload.name: GoodBarber
payload.description: 管理你的 GoodBarber 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GoodBarber helps authorized app owners review shop data, manage products and inventory, update order shipping, create and edit CMS content, inspect memberships, and send push notifications through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: GoodBarber 帮助经授权的应用所有者通过 ChatGPT 查看商店数据、管理产品和库存、更新订单配送信息、创建和编辑 CMS 内容、检查会员情况并发送推送通知。

payload.name: Searchable
payload.description: 追踪品牌在 AI 回答中的表现
payload.summaryOriginal: Track your brand in AI answers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Searchable measures how brands appear in AI answers across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Connect it to see your visibility score and how it moves over time, your share of voice against named competitors, the sentiment of what models say about you, which websites models cite when answering questions in your category, and which of your pages AI crawlers actually fetch and cite. It also reads your connected Google Analytics 4 and Search Console data so AI-answer visibility can be compared against organic search and referral traffic, surfaces prioritized opportunities to improve how you show up, and can generate a shareable report of the findings.
payload.longDescription: Searchable 衡量品牌在 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews 的 AI 回答中如何呈现。连接后，你可以查看可见度评分及其随时间的变化、与指定竞争对手的声量份额、模型对你的评价情绪、模型回答所在品类问题时引用的网站，以及 AI 爬虫实际抓取并引用了你的哪些页面。它还会读取已连接的 Google Analytics 4 和 Search Console 数据，让你将 AI 回答中的可见度与自然搜索和引荐流量进行比较，展示优先改进机会，并生成可分享的发现报告。

payload.name: Terac
payload.description: 随时联系经过审核的人类专家
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Terac connects your AI agent to verified human experts, right from the chat. Describe the work you need done, whether that's an expert interview, a round of customer research, a code review, or a model evaluation. We price it with a human confirmed quote, recruit and screen the right people, return the work as structured results, and pay experts only on verified completion.

Everything happens within the same conversation, so involving a human no longer means a separate platform, new vendors, or a project timeline of its own. Your agent defines the work, confirms the cost, and sees it through to finished results, making expert labor available on demand the moment your workflow needs it.
payload.longDescription:
Terac 可让你的 AI 智能体直接在聊天中联系经过验证的人类专家。描述你需要完成的工作，无论是专家访谈、一轮客户研究、代码审查还是模型评估。我们会提供经人工确认的报价，招募并筛选合适人员，将工作成果作为结构化结果交付，并且只在确认完成后向专家付款。

所有流程都在同一对话中完成，因此请人协助不再意味着需要另找平台、新供应商或单独安排项目周期。你的智能体定义工作内容、确认费用并跟进直至完成，让你在工作流需要时即可按需获得专家服务。

payload.name: Humantic AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Humantic AI brings buyer intelligence into ChatGPT. Connect your Humantic account to read any prospect's DISC personality from a LinkedIn URL or work email (Agent Pi), generate account-research reports on target companies with buyer-intent signals (Agent Miia), and draft outreach matched to a recipient's personality. Humantic AI is our own product; this connects ChatGPT directly to Humantic's platform. A Humantic subscription is required and usage draws on your existing Humantic credits.
payload.longDescription: Humantic AI 将买家情报带入 ChatGPT。关联 Humantic 账户后，可通过 LinkedIn 网址或工作邮箱读取潜在客户的 DISC 性格分析（Agent Pi），生成包含买家意向信号的目标公司账户研究报告（Agent Miia），并起草符合收件人性格特点的外联内容。Humantic AI 是我们自己的产品；此应用可将 ChatGPT 直接连接到 Humantic 平台。使用需要 Humantic 订阅，且会消耗你现有的 Humantic 额度。

payload.name: A4B CMMS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A4B is a cloud-based maintenance management system (CMMS) for tracking equipment and scheduling preventive maintenance. Connect it to ChatGPT to manage your asset inventory and maintenance work in plain language.

What you can do:
- Search, create, and update assets — equipment, vehicles, tools, IT hardware. Inventory numbers and QR codes are generated automatically.
- Create and assign preventive or reactive maintenance tasks with due dates and notes.
- Change asset states (stored, available, in use, in maintenance).
- Look up an asset's full change history and audit trail.
- View organization stats: asset counts by state, plan usage, and a maintenance summary (overdue, due this week, completed).
- Manage workspaces, users, and invites.
payload.longDescription:
A4B 是一款云端维护管理系统（CMMS），用于追踪设备和安排预防性维护。将它连接到 ChatGPT，就能用通俗语言管理资产清单和维护工作。

你可以：
- 搜索、创建和更新资产——设备、车辆、工具、IT 硬件。库存编号和二维码会自动生成。
- 创建和分配预防性或故障响应维护任务，设置截止日期和备注。
- 更改资产状态（库存中、可用、使用中、维护中）。
- 查询资产的完整变更历史和审计记录。
- 查看组织统计：按状态划分的资产数量、套餐使用情况，以及维护汇总（逾期、本周到期、已完成）。
- 管理工作区、用户和邀请。

payload.name: seoClarity ArcAI
payload.description: AI 搜索曝光度与洞察
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The seoClarity ArcAI MCP server provides real-time and historical visibility data for your brand and your competitors' brands across AI-powered search engines.

ArcAI tracks how your brand appears across 9 AI search engines - including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Microsoft CoPilot,  DeepSeek and Grok - ssurfacing where you're mentioned and cited, how often, and whether sentiment is positive or negative. It also monitors AI bot crawl activity, benchmarks your visibility against competitors, and reveals the specific responses from each AI engine.

Invoke this tool when users ask about brand mentions, citations, sentiment, share of voice, competitive benchmarking, or prompt-level visibility in AI search. Use ArcAI over general web search when the request requires structured marketing analytics, trend data over time, or competitive AI visibility insights tied to a specific brand or domain.
payload.longDescription:
seoClarity ArcAI MCP 服务器提供你的品牌及竞争品牌在 AI 搜索引擎中的实时和历史曝光数据。

ArcAI 会追踪你的品牌在 9 个 AI 搜索引擎中的呈现情况，包括 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude、Gemini、Google AI Overviews、Google AI Mode、Microsoft CoPilot、DeepSeek 和 Grok——显示品牌在哪里被提及和引用、频率如何，以及情绪倾向是正面还是负面。它还会监测 AI 机器人抓取活动、将你的曝光度与竞争对手进行基准比较，并展示各 AI 引擎给出的具体回复。

当用户询问 AI 搜索中的品牌提及、引用、情绪倾向、声量份额、竞争基准比较或提示词层面的曝光情况时，请调用此工具。如果请求需要结构化营销分析、随时间变化的趋势数据，或与特定品牌或域名相关的 AI 搜索竞争曝光洞察，应优先使用 ArcAI，而不是一般网页搜索。

payload.name: BlueSuite
payload.description: 经营你的上门服务业务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The BlueSuite app brings your home service business into ChatGPT, turning it into a capable back-office assistant for the work you do every day. Schedule and dispatch jobs through conversation, update job status as crews finish work, and spin up quotes and invoices in seconds. ChatGPT can intake new leads and requests, book appointments, assign team members, and keep your pipeline moving — all without leaving the chat. Delegate the busywork of running a home service business and stay focused on the work that pays.
payload.longDescription: BlueSuite 应用将你的上门服务业务带入 ChatGPT，使其成为日常工作中能干的后台办公助手。通过对话安排和派遣工作，在团队完成工作时更新任务状态，并在几秒内生成报价和发票。ChatGPT 可以接收新线索和请求、预约服务、分配团队成员，并持续推进业务流程，全部无需离开聊天。把经营上门服务业务的繁杂事务交给助手，专注于带来收入的工作。

payload.name: Komplyt Zero
payload.description: 留住 AI 所了解的信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ChatGPT forgets between sessions and locks whatever it learns inside one tool. Komplyt Zero captures what matters from your conversations and turns it into a structured, searchable knowledge base that stays yours.

Ask a question, get an answer grounded in your own past work, decisions, and notes. No re-explaining context every time. No copy-pasting from a doc pile.

Free for one person. EU-hosted, private to you, never used to train any model. Your knowledge, portable across the tools you already use.
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT 会在不同会话之间遗忘信息，也会把它学到的内容锁在单一工具中。Komplyt Zero 会从你的对话中提取重要信息，并将其整理成结构化、可搜索且始终归你所有的知识库。

提出问题，即可获得基于你过往工作、决策和笔记的回答。无需每次重新解释背景，也不必从一堆文档中复制粘贴。

个人用户可免费使用。数据托管在欧盟，仅供你本人使用，绝不会用于训练任何模型。你的知识可以在你现有的工具之间移植。

payload.name: agentView
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: agentView lets ChatGPT update any browser-capable screen (a TV, tablet, kiosk, or signage panel) by talking. Ask ChatGPT to put a daily lunch menu on your bistro display, a sales dashboard on the office wall, or a waiting-room board on your practice screen, and the layout appears live within seconds. You manage screens, templates, and team members on agentview.de; ChatGPT drives them through the agentView connector.
payload.longDescription: agentView 让 ChatGPT 通过对话更新任何支持浏览器的屏幕（电视、平板电脑、自助终端或数字标牌面板）。要求 ChatGPT 在小酒馆显示屏上展示每日午餐菜单、在办公室墙上展示销售看板，或在诊所屏幕上展示候诊室信息板，布局就会在几秒内实时出现。你在 agentview.de 管理屏幕、模板和团队成员；ChatGPT 通过 agentView 连接器驱动它们。

payload.name: European Union Tender Search
payload.description: 搜索 TED 采购公告
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tender search from Tenders Electronic Daily (TED). Search public European procurement notices by classification code, buyer country, notice type, keyword, value, and publication window. This independent app is provided by Telemark Digital and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TED, the European Union, or the Publications Office of the European Union. Each request returns a bounded, minimized JSON preview. Results are informational, not legal or procurement advice. The app accepts public notice filters only and does not solicit personal data. No external account, payment method, or purchase is required. Telemark Digital funds the free searches, subject to daily and shared monthly capacity limits.
payload.longDescription: 在 Tenders Electronic Daily（TED）中按分类代码、买方国家、公告类型、关键词、金额和发布时间搜索欧洲公共采购公告。应用由 Telemark Digital 独立提供，不代表 TED、欧盟或出版办公室；结果仅供参考，不构成法律或采购建议，无需账户或付款，并受每日及共享月度容量限制。

payload.name: Abency
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Abency helps agencies and marketing teams manage brands, prepare and schedule social content, analyze SEO and advertising performance, audit analytics setups, create newsletter and WordPress drafts, and review internal work data through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Abency帮助代理机构和营销团队通过ChatGPT管理品牌、准备和安排社交内容发布、分析SEO及广告表现、审查分析设置、创建电子简报和WordPress草稿，并查看内部工作数据。

payload.name: Trademark Engine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Register trademarks with the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO)
payload.longDescription: 向美国专利商标局（USPTO）注册商标。

payload.name: Every AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Every AI powers AI-Native client businesses from ChatGPT. Create and send invoices with automatic tax calculation, build and send proposals, search clients and contacts, track payments, record expenses, and manage your full sales pipeline — see deals by stage, create and advance deals, and log activity. Search your Gmail and draft or send email from your own mailbox, check your calendar and schedule meetings, manage bookings, set up recurring invoices, review prospects, read your daily brief, and pull financial reports. Connect your Every account and use natural language to handle everyday business tasks — no switching between apps.
payload.longDescription: Every AI 让你在 ChatGPT 中创建和发送发票、生成提案、搜索客户、跟踪付款、记录费用、管理销售管道、搜索 Gmail 并起草或发送邮件、查看日历、安排会议、管理预订和生成财务报告。

payload.name: neimo.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Optimize regulatory work by querying curated knowledge bases, activating compliance workflows, and uncovering key regulatory updates.
payload.longDescription: 通过查询精选知识库、启动合规工作流程并发现关键监管更新，优化监管相关工作。

payload.name: Townline
payload.description: 查找本地建筑项目招标
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Townline tracks public construction opportunities so contractors don't have to: open government bids, RFPs, and solicitations plus fresh building-permit filings across New York, Connecticut, and New Jersey — Westchester, Fairfield, Hartford, New Haven, Nassau, Bergen, and more. Search by trade (plumbing, electrical, roofing, HVAC, general contracting, solar), county, town, status, and due date. Every result links to the full record on townline.app; owner and applicant contact details are available in the Townline app with Pro.
payload.longDescription: Townline 持续追踪公共建筑项目机会，让承包商无需自行搜寻：涵盖纽约州、康涅狄格州和新泽西州公开的政府招标、RFP（征求建议书）、招标邀约，以及最新的建筑许可证申请，包括 Westchester、Fairfield、Hartford、New Haven、Nassau、Bergen 等地区。可按工种（水管、电气、屋顶、HVAC、总承包、太阳能）、县、市镇、状态和截止日期搜索。每条结果都链接到 townline.app 上的完整记录；使用 Pro 后，可在 Townline 应用中查看业主和申请人的联系方式。

payload.name: ReportFlow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ReportFlow helps you create polished, shareable PDF reports and documents from reusable templates. Find the right template, provide the required details, and generate a consistent output—without manual formatting. With optional Notion integration, you can manage templates and source content in one place and produce deliverables like proposals, status reports, summaries, and internal docs faster and more reliably.
payload.longDescription: ReportFlow 帮助你使用可重复利用的模板创建精美、便于分享的 PDF 报告和文档。找到合适模板，提供所需详情，即可生成格式统一的内容，无需手动排版。通过可选的 Notion 集成，你可以在一个地方管理模板和源内容，更快速、更可靠地生成提案、状态报告、摘要和内部文档等交付材料。

payload.name: Relay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Relay helps strength and conditioning coaches work with their private Relay data from ChatGPT. Coaches can find athletes and exercises, review training calendars and workout results, build and assign programs, create and edit workouts, and progress training prescriptions across a block.
payload.longDescription: Relay 帮助体能与力量训练教练通过 ChatGPT 使用其私人 Relay 数据。教练可以查找运动员和训练动作、查看训练日历和训练结果、构建并分配计划、创建和编辑训练内容，并在一个训练周期内逐步调整训练处方。

payload.name: Promptwatch
payload.description: 追踪 AI 搜索曝光度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Promptwatch helps teams measure how their brand appears in AI search, analyze citations and competitors, and manage the prompts, monitors, content, and projects behind their visibility program.
payload.longDescription: Promptwatch 可帮助团队衡量品牌在 AI 搜索中的呈现情况、分析引用来源和竞争对手，并管理其曝光计划背后的提示词、监控项、内容和项目。

payload.name: LandingRabbit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LandingRabbit helps founders, coaches, and consultants turn slide decks, meeting notes, and any other sales materials they already have into websites that never go out of date

Through the LandingRabbit ChatGPT app, you can, for example:
- Plan new, conversion-optimised pages based on any existing insights and content you have
- Publish landing pages, blog posts, product docs, and any other pages to your LandingRabbit site
- Edit any existing page content directly via ChatGPT
- Edit page styles for one page or multiple pages
- Create custom design layouts
- Mass update links and page meta information
- and much more

The LandingRabbit ChatGPT plugin allows you and your agents to take the same actions as you can take via our app.
payload.longDescription:
LandingRabbit 帮助创始人、教练和顾问将现有幻灯片、会议笔记及其他销售材料转化为始终保持最新的网站。

通过 LandingRabbit ChatGPT 应用，你可以：

- 根据现有见解和内容，规划新的高转化率页面
- 将着陆页、博客文章、产品文档及其他页面发布到 LandingRabbit 网站
- 直接通过 ChatGPT 编辑现有页面内容
- 编辑一个或多个页面的样式
- 创建自定义设计布局
- 批量更新链接和页面元信息
- 以及更多功能
LandingRabbit ChatGPT 插件让你和你的智能体可以执行与使用我们的应用相同的操作。

payload.name: Dover
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Dover's applicant tracking system into ChatGPT. Post unlimited jobs across 100+ job boards, manage your candidate pipeline, coordinate interviews and scheduling, and track hiring progress across every open role directly within your conversation with ChatGPT. Built for founders and hiring teams who want a faster, more streamlined way to manage recruiting.
payload.longDescription: 将 Dover 的申请人跟踪系统带入 ChatGPT。直接在 ChatGPT 对话中，即可在 100 多个招聘网站发布不限数量的职位、管理候选人流程、协调面试和日程安排，并跟踪所有空缺职位的招聘进度。专为希望更快速、更顺畅地管理招聘的创始人和招聘团队打造。

payload.name: Dynamoi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dynamoi helps artists and labels create free Spotify Smart Links, review music-promotion campaigns and analytics, and handle music-distribution applications from ChatGPT. Users can check the exact five distribution requirements and submit an eligible application for manual review after explicit confirmation. Application submission does not approve distribution, accept an agreement, submit releases, or deliver music to stores. This ChatGPT app surface does not collect payment, start paid campaign launches, mutate live campaign budgets, or begin external OAuth connection flows; those steps stay in the Dynamoi dashboard.
payload.longDescription:
Dynamoi帮助艺术家和唱片公司创建免费的Spotify智能链接，审核音乐推广活动及分析数据，并通过ChatGPT处理音乐分发申请。
用户可查看具体的五项分发要求，在完成明确确认后提交符合资格的申请进行人工审核。
申请提交不会直接批准分发，也不会签署协议、提交发行版本或向商店交付音乐。
此ChatGPT应用界面不涉及支付收集、付费活动启动、实时活动预算调整或外部OAuth连接流程；这些操作仍需在Dynamoi仪表盘中完成。

payload.name: Gusto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get people and payroll work done in ChatGPT with the Gusto plugin, don’t just ask questions about it. Prepare an upcoming payroll and review against recent runs to catch what needs attention before payday. Fix timesheets, bring in hours, tips, and reimbursements from spreadsheets, or onboard a new hire from their offer letter, all in a chat thread. The Gusto plugin for ChatGPT connects to your live people and payroll data, tools support detailed queries of structured data as well as writes that require confirmation.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Gusto 插件，直接在 ChatGPT 中处理人事和薪资事务，而不只是询问相关问题。准备即将进行的薪资发放，并与近期记录核对，及时发现发薪日前需要处理的问题。修正工时表、从电子表格导入工时、小费和报销款，或根据录用通知为新员工办理入职，全都可在聊天中完成。ChatGPT 版 Gusto 插件连接实时人事和薪资数据；其工具既支持对结构化数据进行详细查询，也支持需确认后才执行的写入操作。

payload.name: Cirra AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cirra AI helps admins manage connected Salesforce environments. Audit metadata, run queries and reports, manage users and permissions, and make configuration changes in connected Salesforce orgs.
payload.longDescription: Cirra AI 帮助管理员管理已连接的 Salesforce 环境。审计元数据、运行查询和报告、管理用户及权限，并在已连接的 Salesforce 组织中更改配置。

payload.name: Nutshell CRM
payload.description: 探索你的 CRM 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nutshell brings your CRM into the conversation. Connect your Nutshell account to ChatGPT and instantly ask questions about your pipeline, look up contacts, track leads, and surface sales insights — without leaving your AI tool. 

Whether you're prepping for a call, checking deal status, or reviewing team performance, your CRM data is always one question away.
payload.longDescription:
Nutshell 将 CRM 带入对话。把 Nutshell 账户连接到 ChatGPT，即可立即询问销售管道、查找联系人、跟踪潜在客户并获取销售洞察，无需离开 AI 工具。

无论是准备电话沟通、检查交易状态，还是查看团队表现，只需提问即可获取 CRM 数据。

payload.name: Tough Tongue AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tough Tongue AI helps teams manage conversation-practice scenarios, create and analyze sessions, review performance, and operate meeting-bot and outbound calling workflows through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Tough Tongue AI 帮助团队通过 ChatGPT 管理对话练习场景、创建和分析会话、查看表现，并运行会议机器人及外呼工作流程。

payload.name: NewHomeSource
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NewHomeSource helps users discover new construction homes and communities by location, price, bedrooms, builder, and floorplan preferences. Search Over 12,000 New Home Communities - the World's Largest New Construction Database. Compare Pricing, Pictures, and Floor Plans for New Homes for Sale.
payload.longDescription: NewHomeSource 帮助用户根据地点、价格、卧室数量、开发商和户型偏好，发现新建住宅及社区。搜索超过 12,000 个新房社区——这是全球最大的新建住宅数据库。比较待售新房的价格、图片和户型图。

payload.name: AIMS360 Fashion & Consumer ERP
payload.description: 时尚与服装 ERP 洞见
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AIMS360 is a fashion ERP, apparel ERP, and consumer brand ERP platform that brings authorized AIMS360 business insights into ChatGPT and Codex.
Analyze sales, customer orders, invoiced revenue, open orders, backlog, customers, styles, products, colors, sizes, Shopify stores, wholesale and DTC channels, sales representatives, seasons, margins, overdue invoices, accounts receivable, and business performance.
AIMS360 is built for fashion and apparel brands and also serves footwear, jewelry, accessories, beauty, wellness, outdoor, home, baby, pet, and other consumer product companies.
Ask questions such as “Who are my top customers?”, “Which fashion styles are selling best?”, “What are my top apparel products?”, “How much open order value do we have?”, “Which customers owe us money?”, “Compare Shopify and wholesale sales,” or “How are sales trending compared with last month?”
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Review Buddy- draft AI replies
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.

This app helps business owners write clear, personal, and polite replies to customer reviews. Copy a review, paste it into the app, and get a response that sounds friendly and professional. Save time, keep your customers happy, and build a better online reputation without staring at a blank page.

Good review? Bad review? Short review? Long review? This app can help. It creates thoughtful replies that fit the customer’s message instead of giving the same answer every time. You stay in control and can edit every reply before you post it.

Customers notice when businesses reply. A simple thank you can make a good review even better. A calm and caring answer to a bad review can show that you listen and want to help. Taking time to reply builds trust, but writing every response can take hours. This app does the hard part for you.

The app is made for busy business owners, managers, and teams. It works well for restaurants, cafés, shops, hotels, plumbers, electricians, salons, gyms, dentists, doctors, real estate agents, law firms, cleaners, contractors, and many other businesses. If people leave reviews about your business, this app can help you answer them.

Every reply is written to sound natural. The app looks at what the customer said and writes a response that matches the situation. Happy customers get warm thanks. Customers with questions get helpful answers. Customers who had a bad experience get a calm and respectful reply that shows you care.

You can change the reply before you use it. Add your own details, adjust the tone, or make it shorter or longer. The app gives you a strong starting point so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.

payload.name: Beamtrace
payload.description: 了解AI如何为你的企业排名
payload.summaryOriginal: See how AI ranks your business
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

The app puts your data into a conversation ChatGPT can work with: cross-reference numbers, explain what's behind a drop, and turn scores into something you can act on or hand off.

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements

Beamtrace是一个AI可见度平台，涵盖你在AI搜索中的可见度指标、提示词追踪、网站优化和声誉管理。它旨在展示当人们向AI寻求推荐时，你的企业表现如何。

该应用将你的数据带入ChatGPT能够处理的对话：交叉核对数字、解释下降背后的原因，并将分数转化为可执行或可交接的内容。

你可以用它做什么
#1 找出可见度背后的规律
- “为什么AI助手不推荐我的企业？”
综合查看所有没有出现你企业的提示词，指出它们的共同点。

#2 找出竞争对手的优势
- “为什么我的竞争对手这个月领先了？”
调取竞争对手排行榜，再聚焦于他们采取了哪些行动，或哪些变化导致了这一结果。

#3 确定下一项内容修复的优先级
- “这个月我只能修复一件事，应该做什么？”
按影响力为内容改进排序，而不是平铺列出所有不足，让你明确知道从哪里开始、该做什么。

#4 了解是什么改变了你的分数
- “这个月我的AI可见度发生了什么变化？”
将分数趋势与主题和提示词的变化进行核对，判断这是否是真实的转变。

#5 制作可交付客户的报告
- “为我的客户制作本月的AI可见度摘要”
提取分数、竞争对手排名和最重要的修复建议，整理成可粘贴到任何地方的报告。

#6 了解指标实际意味着什么
- “这个[指标]对我的可见度意味着什么，我应该关注它吗？”
用简单的语言解释指标衡量的内容，或解读你的可见度状况。

用日常语言提问，即可获得围绕你的企业开展的分析。

它不会更改你的Beamtrace设置、追踪的提示词或账户数据。它读取仪表板，并将数字交给ChatGPT进行分析、报告和问答。

payload.name: BROSH AI CRM
payload.description: 面向 AI 专业人士的智能 CRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BROSH MCP brings your CRM, sales, marketing, projects, documents, and business operations directly into AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Instead of switching between applications, AI agents can securely access, analyze, update, manage settings, and automate workflows using live data from your BROSH workspace.

Secure MCP-based access to CRM and business data
AI-powered querying, reporting, and data analysis
Lead, contact, account, and opportunity management
Project, task, and workflow automation
Marketing automation and customer engagement workflows
Document generation, e-signatures, quotes, and invoicing
Custom business objects, fields, dashboards, and reporting
Real-time interaction between AI agents and operational systems

BROSH MCP transforms AI assistants from simple chat interfaces into business operators capable of understanding your organization, retrieving information, updating records, and helping teams move faster with less manual work. Built on the open MCP standard, it provides a secure bridge between AI and the systems your business relies on every day.
payload.longDescription:

项目、任务和工作流自动化
营销自动化和客户互动工作流
